topic: Buggy's slash immunity makes rubber the only thing that works against him
title: Luffy Loses To Buggy Without The Gum-Gum Fruit
description: Zoro can't cut Buggy and Luffy's rubber is the only reason his blades bounce. A short cut from our full What If: what if Luffy never ate the Gum-Gum Fruit? Full breakdown on the channel. Would Zoro still win?
comment: Without rubber, does Zoro or Nami save Orange Town? Pick one.

lines.text: Luffy loses to Buggy if he never eats the Gum-Gum Fruit.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy buggy orange town, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: I know. Buggy is the clown from the very first arc after Zoro joins.

shot.fallback: anime style buggy orange town clown, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But Buggy ate the Bara Bara no Mi, the Chop-Chop Fruit, and it makes him immune to slashing.

shot.search: Buggy Bara Bara no Mi slashing
shot.fallback: anime style buggy bara bara no mi slashing, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That means Zoro, the Pirate Hunter, can't cut him. Not once.

shot.fallback: anime style zoro swords buggy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Luffy's rubber body is the only reason Buggy's flying blades just bounce off.

shot.fallback: anime style buggy flying hands knives luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Zoro would just win anyway. But swords are useless against a man who can't be cut.

shot.fallback: anime style zoro buggy orange town fight, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So who's left? Nami. She's the one who traps Buggy's floating limbs.

shot.fallback: anime style nami traps buggy parts, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And even that only works because Luffy can take a hit and finish him with one punch.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy punches buggy away, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Without rubber, those same knives are slicing a real kid.

shot.fallback: anime style buggy knife hands luffy blood, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That's the thing about the first arc. The fruit isn't a power-up. It's the whole plan.

shot.search: Luffy Gomu Gomu no Mi Orange Town
shot.fallback: anime style luffy gomu gomu no mi orange town, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Take the fruit away, and honestly,

shot.fallback: anime style luffy buggy orange town, dramatic lighting, no text
